Explore on-device vision and audio models. Inputs are processed on your device; models download when you choose.
Model execution was tested on Galaxy S26. Output quality varies by task and input; results are demonstrations, not guarantees.
Choose a photo or take one, then run the model.
Photos are limited to 512 pixels on the longest side before 4× upscaling.

Separation takes about 45 s on Galaxy S26. The three stems run one at a time to limit peak GPU memory.
%1$s (%2$d bytes) of model files will be downloaded.
Free storage must be at least twice the model size. Files are checked before use and can be deleted in Models.
This network is metered. Downloading may use your mobile data allowance or incur charges.
LiteRT Model Zoo uses the camera only when you choose a photo or live camera task. Images are processed on your device and are never uploaded. You can choose an existing image instead.
LiteRT Model Zoo uses the microphone only when you choose to record speech. Audio is processed on your device and is never uploaded. You can choose a WAV file instead.
LiteRT Model Zoo uses the microphone only when you choose to record audio. Audio is processed on your device and is never uploaded. You can choose a WAV file instead.
Android will not ask again. Open settings, choose Permissions, and allow access while using the app. Return here to continue.
LiteRT Model Zoo uses the following open-source libraries and additional SDKs. Links open the license text or project in your browser. Model-specific licenses and credits are listed on About.
